title: Quick pickled cauliflower with cheddar toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or a basic staple: cauliflower, carrot, shallots, cider vinegar, sugar, spices, bread and cheddar.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any Tesco at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board, small pan, bowl or jar and a toaster or grill, with simple slicing and warming.

works.reason: 350ml of brine suits one small cauliflower with a carrot, 30 minutes gives a crisp quick pickle, and 4 cheddar toasts make a fair snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers cutting the veg, warming the brine, toasting and slicing the cheese, and the 30 unattended minutes match the pickling step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, nothing unlisted appears apart from water, and 'wholemeal bread' matches the bread id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Garden cauliflower is the bulk and the point of the pickle, which suits a late April afternoon.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal toast with cheddar and a pile of pickled vegetables is a satisfying, real-food snack.
